segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Priya. I had 30 minutes down to confirm the seat count and target go-live for the analytics workspace.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep. We’re at 38 users for launch, with probably another 6 in September. I don’t want to buy 50 seats if we’re not using them yet.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fair. The cleanest setup is 40 seats on the initial order, then you can add seats mid-term at the same unit rate. For 40, it’s $29,600 annually, invoiced net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And if we add 6 seats in September, is that prorated through the same end date?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Same contract end date, June 30, 2027. The September add-on would just be prorated for the remaining months.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Our finance team also asked whether implementation is separate or included.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For your package, the standard onboarding is included: two admin sessions, one end-user training, and the migration checklist. If you want us to do the historical import for you, that’s a one-time $3,200 services line.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let’s skip the import for now. We can handle the last twelve months ourselves. Go-live is still August 12, assuming we can get the order done this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. I’ll send the order form for 40 seats, annual billing, no paid services, start date July 15, and target go-live August 12.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy Mark in procurement. If the invoice can reference PO 78441, that’ll keep it moving.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll include PO 78441 on the billing notes and send the signature link today.
